Herod the king stretched forth his: This name Herod was common to all those that come from the stock of Herod Ascalonites, whose surname was Magnus: but he that is spoken of here was nephew to Herod the great, son to Aristobulus, and father to the Agrippa who is spoken of afterwards.
killed James the brother of John: Violently, his cause not being heard at all.
And because he saw it pleased: It is an old habit of tyrants to attain the favour of the wicked, with the blood of the godly.
And when he had apprehended him: The tyrants and wicked make a gallows for themselves even then when they do most according to their own will and fantasy.

Peter therefore was kept in prison: The prayers of the godly overturn the counsel of tyrants, obtain angels from God, break the prison, unloose the chains, put Satan to flight, and preserve the Church.
